summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for the standalone, secure TypeScript Agentic LLM Platform Workbench UI. 

This plan details the specialized translation of the Perchance chat layout into an enterprise-grade agentic workbench:
- Decouples the frontend as a self-contained, isolated TypeScript module (modules/ui-agentic-workbench) with zero compile-time dependencies on the backend or Java core.
- Re-architects the default 'Chloe' entity as the built-in Gemini Architectural & Diagnostic Helper, and transforms additional 'characters' into specialized AgentForge subagents governed by TaskContracts and Rule DAGs.
- Replaces image generation with Workspace Folder & File Linking.
- Maps the interactive UI components: thread/session management, inline turn editing/deletion/regeneration, stream perspective selector (Agent, Operator, System Kernel, Workspace Link), and local-first JSON backup export/import.
- Outlines the clean API/SSE bridge connecting to the LeanJavallm core (zero-dep RFC 8259 JSON engine, SecureSecret, ProcessTreeTerminator) and AgentForge multi-agent runtime.
